tools.name: hilo_list_services

tools.name: hilo_get_pricing

tools.name: hilo_list_projects

tools.name: hilo_get_case_study

tools.name: hilo_get_blog_post

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hilo_list_services, hilo_list_projects, hilo_list_blog_posts, hilo_get_blog_post · Private data: hilo_studio_overview, hilo_recommend, hilo_request_quote · Public sink: hilo_get_blog_post, hilo_request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hilo_list_services, hilo_list_projects, hilo_list_blog_posts, hilo_get_blog_post · Private data: hilo_studio_overview, hilo_recommend, hilo_request_quote · Public sink: hilo_get_blog_post, hilo_request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
